subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence prioritization and renewal capacity ask
messages:
From: Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@fracturepay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: audit_ops@fracturepay.com
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation window + retention exception request

Marissa —

We’re kicking off our renewal review for FracturePay (contract FP-1179). Procurement signaled we need the SOC 2 re-attestation run for our renewal window (target contract renewal: 2028-10-15). Two asks from our side: 1) can Redwood re-run the attestation/update the SOC 2 report to include the new retention policy we discussed (90 -> 365 days for audit logs), and 2) we may expand seats by ~30% if the renewal and retention exception are accepted.

We have an internal audit window 2028-10-01 to 2028-10-12 and need artifacts staged for that period. What’s the minimal evidence slice you can provide first so we can start our control testing while you stage the rest? Also — do you have an exceptions flow for temporary retention increases during a renewal cycle?

Thanks,
Dana
Director, Security & Compliance
FracturePay

--
Attachment: fracture_evidence_request_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with initial control list)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@fracturepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation window + retention exception request

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear asks and timeline. We can support a temporary retention uplift to 365d for the audit window and we can prioritize a compact evidence slice to unblock your testers early.

Plan (high level):
- Stage "core control" artifacts first (authentication, access revocations/logs, deployment change logs, incident reports) — deliver within 5 business days after we get your prioritized control list.
- Follow with supporting evidence (config backups, longer KV cache access patterns, devops playbooks) in a second batch within 10 business days.
- We’ll provide a signed addendum for the temporary retention uplift and a capacity amendment for the +30% seat bump (draft attached).

Next steps I propose: Ben will own the evidence handoff cadence, Karthik will produce a short priority matrix showing which artifacts map to your test cases, and Kimberly will lead the commercial amendment (pricing + DocuSign).

Please confirm the controls you want in the initial slice (you can edit the attached fracture_evidence_request_v1.xlsx). We’ll start the staging immediately after.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: evidence_manifest_v2.pdf (staging checklist)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@fracturepay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation window + retention exception request

Dana — looping in the evidence operations playbook. Quick answers: yes, we can export the auth logs and admin action audit trails for the 365d window; we’ll push them to a secure, read-only GCS folder and provide checksums. For the audit window you mentioned, we can surface a prioritized slice with the following minimal deliverables:

1) Auth events + admin change logs (CSV + parsed index)
2) Role-based access control snapshots (as-of dates)
3) Incident response timeline and root-cause packets for the last 12 months
4) Recent deployment/CI run logs tagged to release IDs you test against

I’ve attached a quick manifest and included the expected delivery timings. We’ll need the edited control list you mentioned and confirmation on whether Glen (your external assessor) needs direct folder access or a downloadable bundle.

Ben Carter
Head of Evidence Ops, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachment: evidence_priority_matrix.xlsx (proposal)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@fracturepay.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Sep 2028 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation window + retention exception request

Adding a technical slice and a mapping table so FracturePay's testers can start before we finish full export:

Priority Matrix (short):
- Slice A (day 0 deliverable): auth_events.csv (last 90d), admin_actions.log (indexed), rbac_snapshot_20280901.json (sanitized)
- Slice B (day 3): ci_deploy_runs.log (tagged), service_account_rotations.csv
- Slice C (day 7): longer retention audit logs (365d export), archived config bundles (if requested)

Notes:
- We will redact PII by default and mark any redactions in the manifest. If you need raw PII-containing artifacts, we require a separate NDA addendum and vault access.
- For direct assessor access we can grant the assessor (Glen Mercer) read-only links to the evidence folder; else we’ll produce signed bundles with checksums.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

--
Attachment: evidence_priority_matrix.xlsx (technical mapping)

From: Glen Mercer <glen.mercer@audithouse.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@fracturepay.com>
Cc: audit_ops@fracturepay.com, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Sep 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation window + retention exception request

Thanks — Glen from AuditHouse here. Read-only folder access is preferable for our team; downloadable bundles are acceptable as a fallback but slow for iterative testing. Two items from our side:

1) We’ll need preservation of original timestamps and a manifest indicating any redactions.
2) Please include a CSV mapping artifact -> control ID (e.g., CC6.2 -> admin_actions.log) so our testers can mark pass/fail quickly.

If Redwood can provide a read-only GCS link and a manifest CSV, we can start testing Slice A on 2028-09-18. That timing works for us.

Glen Mercer
Principal Auditor, AuditHouse

--

Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation window + retention exception request

All — thanks for the quick alignment. Confirming the operational plan and next steps:

1) Redwood will provision a read-only GCS folder for AuditHouse by EOD 2028-09-17. Link will be shared with checksums and manifest_v2.csv.
2) Slice A (auth + admin + rbac snapshot) to be uploaded by 2028-09-18 morning (PST) — Glen to validate.
3) We’ll issue a temporary retention addendum (signed PDF) that covers 2028-09-01 through 2029-01-01 to cover your audit plus a 45-day buffer; Kimberly will send the DocuSign link for the addendum and the capacity amendment (FP-1179 seat +30%).
4) Commercial: Kimberly — please propose the amended monthly pricing and the DocuSign for the amendment by Monday 2028-09-18.

Marissa will monitor daily and set a short daily stand (10 min) if the auditors request clarifications during the first two test days. If anyone needs a different timeline, flag now.

Thanks — excited to get FracturePay across the finish line for renewal and expansion.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: capacity_amendment_draft.pdf (draft for +30% seats)
